text:
nora: Photo drop — Whiskers discovered the sunbeams and is now doing sprint intervals across the conference table. pic: https://i.imgur.com/whiskers-sun.jpg :sun_with_face:

eli: that leap at 11s is Olympic level :medal_sports:

zoe: do we have a "cat sprint" leaderboard yet? i demand metrics.

facilities-bot: Reminder: please do not leave food on conference tables. See policy: https://intra.redwood/clean.

nora: noted. Whiskers apologizes and offers a tiny ribbon as restitution. ribbon photo: https://i.imgur.com/whiskers-ribbon.jpg

giphy: GIF: cat zoomies (posted)

eli: suggestion: bring a tiny foam starting block for the next sprint. i'll supply.

zoe: poll: name the sprint move — "sunbeam dash" :white_check_mark: or "conference table cruise" :eyes:

nora: :white_check_mark: sunbeam dash for the win

eli: :white_check_mark: yes

zoe: next steps: record 10-second slo-mo and add to morale playlist. marketing tagged if external share ok.

nora: done. thanks team! (reacts: :heart: from eli)
